characters.name: luca
characters.prompt: Use case: transparent game foreground overlay. Image 1 is POSE/PLACEMENT/PIXEL ART STYLE reference. Image 2 shows actual character models labeled with names; match ONLY LUCA's skin and sleeve. Output ONE isolated left arm and clenched hand checking a wristwatch on a genuinely transparent background, with exactly the same wide 16:9 canvas and absolute positioning as image 1. Arm enters from lower LEFT edge, rises diagonally toward wrist at approximately x=50%,y=75%, hand to right ending at x=74%,y=92%. Original arm top contour starts at (0%,90%) and passes (44%,67%); knuckles near (65%,60%). Match original pose, fist orientation and scale. Character: warm light tan skin; turquoise/teal hoodie sleeve with thick rolled cuff ending at mid forearm. Show bare forearm between rolled cuff and watch consistent with character's model. Keep original round cream analog watch, dark brown leather strap, same location and size, hands indicating around 8:03. Crisp pixel-painted shaded game illustration matching image 1, no photographic rendering. Entire top 59% and right 25% of canvas must be EMPTY TRANSPARENT. No car, trees, road, scenery, labels, text, checkerboard pixels, ground shadow or background. Do not center or zoom the arm; preserve lower-left placement so PNG overlays directly on background at full canvas size.
